summary: community.routeros no longer supports Ansible 2.9 to ansible-core 2.14. Users on EOL versions should stay on community.routeros 2.x.
questions: Which routeros collection version works with Ansible 2.9?

answer_card.title: community.routeros on EOL Ansible
answer_card.answer_md: community.routeros 3.x drops Ansible 2.9 through ansible-core 2.14. Stay on community.routeros 2.x if you need those versions.
